  title: "WheelMates PC System Requirements: Can Your Rig Run It?",
  description: "Check the official minimum and recommended PC system requirements for WheelMates. Learn about CPU, GPU, RAM, and storage specs.",

To run the miniature cooperative adventure game WheelMates on PC, your system must meet specific hardware standards. At a minimum, your computer needs an Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 processor, paired with an NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580 graphics card and 8 GB of RAM. 

For players who want to experience the cluttered household environments and physics-heavy platforming at higher frame rates and resolutions, the recommended specifications call for an Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X CPU, alongside an NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600 XT GPU and 16 GB of RAM.

WheelMates is a dedicated cooperative experience designed around remote-controlled (RC) car physics, split-screen gameplay, and interactive environments. Because the game renders highly detailed household levels from a miniature perspective, having the right hardware is essential for maintaining smooth controls.

---

## WheelMates Minimum PC System Requirements

The minimum system requirements for WheelMates are designed to ensure the game is playable at lower graphical settings. These specifications are accessible for budget gaming setups and older systems.

| Hardware Component | Minimum Requirement |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Operating System** | Windows 10/11 (64-bit) |
| **Processor (CPU)** | Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 |
| **Memory (RAM)** | 8 GB |
| **Graphics Card (GPU)** | NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 |
| **Dedicated Video RAM** | 3072 MB (3 GB) |
| **Shader Model** | Version 6.0 |
| **Storage Space** | 15 GB available space |

Running the game on the minimum specifications will allow you to experience the main story and local split-screen mode, though you may need to lower your resolution or graphical presets to maintain a stable frame rate during intense physics sequences.

---

## WheelMates Recommended PC System Requirements

To experience WheelMates with high-definition textures, advanced lighting, and stable performance during split-screen play, your PC should meet or exceed the recommended specifications.

| Hardware Component | Recommended Requirement |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Operating System** | Windows 10/11 (64-bit) |
| **Processor (CPU)** | Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X |
| **Memory (RAM)** | 16 GB |
| **Graphics Card (GPU)** | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT |
| **Dedicated Video RAM** | 8192 MB (8 GB) |
| **Shader Model** | Version 6.0 |
| **Storage Space** | 15 GB available space |

Meeting these recommended specs ensures that your system can handle the game's complex rendering demands, such as real-time shadows, reflective surfaces in the kitchen and swimming pool levels, and fast-paced RC car maneuvers without performance drops.

---

## Hardware Breakdown and Performance Analysis

Understanding how WheelMates utilizes your hardware can help you optimize your settings for the best possible gameplay experience.

### Graphics Card and VRAM Demands
WheelMates requires a graphics card that supports Shader Model 6.0. The minimum requirement of 3 GB of dedicated VRAM (satisfied by the GTX 1060 or RX 580) is necessary to load the game's highly detailed, cluttered environments. Levels are packed with interactive assets like cardboard bridges, empty soda cans, and stacked boxes. 

Upgrading to the recommended 8 GB of VRAM (RTX 3060 or RX 6600 XT) allows the game to load high-resolution textures and handle complex visual effects, such as the glowing green BH19 bipod hazards and the portal transitions into the game's alternate dimensions.

### Processor and Memory Utilization
The game relies heavily on real-time physics calculations. Players control RC cars equipped with grappling hooks, magnets, and magnetic tires that allow them to climb walls and drive upside down on metal ceilings. These mechanics, along with the ability to push heavy objects like scissor lifts and launch off ramps, put a significant load on your CPU. 

An 8-core processor like the Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X is recommended to process these physics calculations smoothly, especially when two players are interacting with different parts of a level simultaneously.

### Storage Requirements
WheelMates requires 15 GB of free disk space. While the system requirements do not strictly mandate an Solid State Drive (SSD), installing the game on an SSD is highly recommended. An SSD will significantly reduce loading times when transitioning between large, open levels like the kitchen, the backyard shed, the air vents, and the swimming pool.

---

## Gameplay Features That Impact PC Performance

Several unique gameplay mechanics in WheelMates can place additional strain on your PC's hardware.

### Local Split-Screen Rendering
WheelMates can be played via local split-screen or online co-op. When playing in local split-screen, your graphics card must render two separate viewpoints at the same time. This virtually doubles the rendering workload, which can cause noticeable frame rate drops on systems that only meet the minimum requirements. If you plan to play local split-screen frequently, aiming for the recommended hardware is highly advised.

### Physics-Based Puzzle Solving
The core gameplay loop of WheelMates involves manipulating the environment using special abilities:
*   **Grappling Hooks:** Used to swing across gaps, pull levers, and open large drawers.
*   **Magnets:** Used to grab non-magnetic items (like oranges) or carry batteries to power sockets.
*   **Magnetic Tires:** Used to adhere to metal tracks on walls and ceilings.
*   **Paint Guns:** Used to shoot targets and activate timed switches.

Each of these tools interacts dynamically with the game world. When both players use their abilities at the same time, the physics engine must calculate multiple points of tension, gravity, and momentum, requiring robust CPU performance.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I play WheelMates by myself?
No, WheelMates is strictly a cooperative game and cannot be played alone. You must play with a partner, either via local split-screen or online co-op. Fortunately, the game features a free Friends Pass, meaning only one player needs to own the full game for two players to play together online.

### What happens if my RC car gets stuck in the environment?
Because the game features realistic RC car physics, your vehicle can occasionally get caught on clutter or tight corners. If your car becomes permanently stuck, you can use the self-reset feature, which causes your vehicle to explode and safely respawn at the nearest checkpoint.

### Is there a difference in system requirements for the host and the client?
Both players need to meet the minimum system requirements to run the game smoothly. However, the host of an online session may experience slightly higher CPU and network utilization, as their system must synchronize the physics states, collectible locations, and puzzle progress for both players.
